items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Koenig would call me... Andre Previn told me to ask you, could he be on the next session

ctx.x: I don't remember that. But I know I made it, and the man who recorded it, he put his name on it. It was supposed to be his number. And then Mr. Koenig had a terrible time getting his name off of it.
